# ZOZ INNOVATIONS FZCO

> ZOZ Innovations is a licensed AI and spatial studio in Dubai. We direct cinematic AI commercials, architect autonomous multi-agent systems, engineer iOS apps and websites, and turn 2D floor plans into photorealistic 3D walkthroughs. Shipped in weeks, with zero agency overhead.

## About the Organization
- **Legal Name**: ZOZ INNOVATIONS FZCO
- **Jurisdiction & License**: IFZA Licensed (Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai, United Arab Emirates)
- **Primary Focus**: AI commercials, AI agents and automation, iOS apps, websites, 3D walkthroughs from floor plans
- **Website**: https://zozinnovations.com
- **Contact**: info@zozinnovations.com | WhatsApp: +971 54 702 1511

## Founders
- **Zoya Anywhere**, Co-Founder & CEO, DevOps engineer, 8 years in the industry. Directs the AI films and ads, runs servers, and models in Maya, After Effects and AutoCAD. Portfolio: https://zoyanywhere.com
- **Oliver Richter**, Co-Founder & CTO, DevOps engineer, 10 years in engineering. Builds the AI products and the infrastructure behind them, and turns floor plans into Blender walkthroughs.

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. AI Agents & Automation
- **AI Customer Support & Sales Agents**: Autonomous assistants that handle client inquiries, qualify leads, and book meetings 24/7 across Web and WhatsApp.
- **Multi-Agent Systems**: teams of AI agents that split a project into roles and finish it together (demo: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/1hOzcvk4eTM).
- **Voice Agents**: AI voice assistants that take calls and answer questions (demo: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/L3Vt1ny65Sk).
- **Workflow Automation**: Tailored LLM-powered back-office workflows and data processing pipelines.
- **AI Media & Video Generation**: Synthetic video production and generative marketing content for brands.

### 2. Mobile App Development
- **Native iOS / Swift Engineering**: Full-cycle development from product design to App Store publication.
- **Rapid Prototyping & Launch**: MVPs launched to the App Store in 2–4 weeks.
- **Production Reference**: FocusTime Daily (Focus & Productivity Timer live on Apple App Store).

### 3. High-Performance Web & Platform Development
- **Custom Web Platforms**: Modern, ultra-fast web applications built with modern frontend frameworks and containerized deployments.
- **Interactive Calculators & Business Tools**: High-impact regional compliance and calculation tools.
- **Production Reference**: Sugar Tax UAE (First comprehensive UAE Sugar Excise Tax Calculator at https://sugartaxuae.ae).

### 4. AI Video & Commercials
- **AI commercials and films**: directed by Zoya Anywhere. Spec ads, brand intros and short films made with Seedance, Veo and Higgsfield.
- **Production Reference**: The Secret Life of Resonance (AI film, 1 Billion Followers Summit submission). Full portfolio: https://zoyanywhere.com/portfolio/

### 5. 3D Walkthroughs from Floor Plans
- **Floor plan to 3D**: a 2D floor plan becomes a furnished Blender model, a walkthrough video and listing stills.
- **Production Reference**: 3D walkthrough of a Dubai apartment built from its floor plan (https://www.youtube.com/shorts/L_QeP63UPLA)

## Key Projects & References
